title: Python: duplicate imports of the same symbol are one binding for known-class binding from an annotation (DEC-303 (a93) item 1)
description: Accepted hold task for rich misses 5.7 (rich/rule.py:66) and 5.8 (rich/table.py:491), classified under DEC-303 (a92) item 3 and ruled by (a93) item 1. Measured at dev dce9e90: a module that imports the same class name twice suppresses known-class binding from the annotation, even though both imports bind the same class; rule.py imports Console at line 3 (relative) and 118 (absolute, in its __main__ demo), table.py at 18-25 (TYPE_CHECKING) and 929 (absolute). Ruling: duplicate imports of the SAME symbol become one binding. Fixtures cover 5.7's __main__ shape and 5.8's closure read. Refused twins must still refuse: two imports binding DIFFERENT symbols, an import followed by a non-import rebinding, and a conditional import of a different symbol. Mutants observed red. Two rounds; every created and removed in-repo edge on the five-pin corpus is listed to opum-doc before the clear. Runs after GCLI-151, which is landed. ALSO CARRIES the N5 item from the #262 round-2 review, per opum-doc's ruling on the #262 landing (ODOC-640, opum-ai/opum-doc#2113): the 6d constructed arm checks hasReplacingDecorator but not instanceClassOf, so a C whose __new__ returns a writing descendant still resolves x = C(); x.m(). MEASURED on dev 5e9f4215, read-only: with C.__new__ returning D() and D(C).__init__ writing self.__class__ = Other, x = C(); x.m() gives app.py:C.m; the no-write twin gives C.m and the no-__new__ control gives C.m, so the with-write site is a REAL wrong edge. It is removal-only by construction (refusing drops the edge), with a fixture pair and a mutant required. The guard would consult instanceClassOf in knownClassOf's call arm; because that touches every x = C() binding, the blast radius on the five pins and the corpus must be measured before building and every removed edge listed to opum-doc. Built inside this task's two rounds and intended-delta report, NOT as a new task or round; if it will not fit removal-only it becomes a stated limit plus an item on GCLI-172.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A module that imports the same class twice (relative and absolute, in any scope) resolves an annotated receiver method call to the class method; fixtures cover the 5.7 __main__ shape and the 5.8 closure read
Two imports binding different symbols, an import followed by a non-import rebinding, and a conditional import of a different symbol all stay unresolved, with fixtures and mutants observed red
Every in-repo edge created or removed on the five-pin corpus is listed to opum-doc before the clear

plan: 1. Measure N5 read-only on dev d0ea6bc: write/no-write/no-__new__ twins over the 6d constructed arm; record the answer before building.
2. Reproduce 5.7 (__main__ duplicate import) and 5.8 (closure read) as failing fixtures on dev.
3. Implement: duplicate imports of the SAME class become one binding in knownClassOf; the 6d constructed arm also consults instanceClassOf (N5), if measurement says removal-only.
4. Refused twins with fixtures and mutants observed red: different symbols, import then non-import rebinding, conditional import of a different symbol.
5. Blast radius over the five pins, the 1394-source corpus and the fixture set; list every created/removed in-repo edge, report to the leader for opum-doc before the clear.
6. Two review rounds, one PR on a task branch off dev, CI by ref, report PR number + head SHA.
implementationNotes: N5 measured FIRST, read-only, on dev d0ea6bc4 (twins, one file): write shape (C.__new__ returns D(); D(C).__init__ writes self.__class__ = Other; x = C(); x.m()) gives app.py:C.m; the no-write twin gives C.m; both no-__new__ controls give C.m. Real pre-existing wrong edge, as the a94 ruling recorded, and removal-only by construction: the fix consults instanceClassOf in knownClassOf's call arm, which can only drop a resolution. Blast radius measured with the GCLI-161 proof kit over the five pins at dev vs the patched tree: 40 created edges (all the duplicate-import annotation fix, concentrated in rich: Console methods through parameters annotated Console, including the two named targets rich/rule.py:66 and rich/table.py:491) and 129 removed edges (all N5: classes whose __new__ may return a descendant, e.g. tqdm.std.tqdm, jinja2.environment.Template, and classes with opaque bases e.g. httpx Headers/QueryParams/Cookies). No edge is created by the N5 half. The full created/removed list is in the PR body and reported to opum-doc before the clear.

DEC-303 (a95) ruled on #264 at b2ed5577: the duplicate-import change is cleared as reported, and N5 does NOT ride. N5 is removed from #264 — the 6d arm and the two moved tests equal dev d0ea6bc4 in the diff, and the N5 fixtures are gone — because as built it also refused where nothing writes (the no-write twin) and removed 129 five-pin edges not shown wrong, spending the recall (a94) item 1 already declined at about 0.91. The N5 measurement (write shape, no-write twin, no-__new__ controls) is carried to GCLI-172 as evidence. Accepted delta for #264 after the removal, against dev d0ea6bc4: exactly the 40 created edges listed in the PR body, 0 corpus removals, 0 flag-changed. Round 1 was not spent; it runs on the new head.
